key: BLAKE: More of the same, huh.
en: BLAKE: More of the same, huh.
ja: ブレイク: また同じような感じか。

key: CAL: I don't think it can have gone too much further...
en: CAL: I don't think it can have gone too much further...
ja: キャル: そんなに遠くまで行けたとは思えないけど……

key: Or at least I hope not.
en: Or at least I hope not.
ja: というか、そうであってほしい。

key: BLAKE: Hey, does something smell weird to you?
en: BLAKE: Hey, does something smell weird to you?
ja: ブレイク: なあ、なんか変な匂いしないか?

key: ...Tsk, normally I'd toss in a line like "And I don't mean Cal" here,
en: ...Tsk, normally I'd toss in a line like "And I don't mean Cal" here,
ja: ……ちっ、いつもならここで「キャルのことじゃないぜ」みたいな一言、挟むところなんだけどな、

key: But I'm pretty sure at least one of you will just dunk me into a lava pool if I do.
en: But I'm pretty sure at least one of you will just dunk me into a lava pool if I do.
ja: でも今それ言ったら、間違いなくどっちかに溶岩に沈められそうだからな。

key: CAL: I'll overlook your implying it anyway.
en: CAL: I'll overlook your implying it anyway.
ja: キャル: どうせほのめかしてるんだろうけど、見逃してあげるよ。

key: What you're smelling is probably some form of volcanic gas.
en: What you're smelling is probably some form of volcanic gas.
ja: 君が嗅いでるのは、たぶん何かの火山ガスだと思う。

key: BLAKE: Dude, take it outside if you're gonna rip one.
en: BLAKE: Dude, take it outside if you're gonna rip one.
ja: ブレイク: おい、へこくなら外でやれよ。

key: CAL: ...
en: CAL: ...
ja: キャル: ……

key: BLAKE: All right, all right, thin ice, lava pools-- I get it!
en: BLAKE: All right, all right, thin ice, lava pools-- I get it!
ja: ブレイク: はいはい、薄氷に、溶岩だまり――分かったよ!

key: Drop the death glare, bro!
en: Drop the death glare, bro!
ja: その殺し屋みたいな目つき、やめてくれよ、兄弟!

key: I know I'm in the doghouse here, but you gotta understand, it's just hard to not make fun of you sometimes.
en: I know I'm in the doghouse here, but you gotta understand, it's just hard to not make fun of you sometimes.
ja: 俺が今お前に嫌われてるのは分かってるけどさ、時々からかわずにいられないってのも分かってくれよ。

key: And I don't mean that as a personal insult.
en: And I don't mean that as a personal insult.
ja: 別に個人的な悪口のつもりじゃないんだ。

key: I'm saying it's not you; it's me.
en: I'm saying it's not you; it's me.
ja: 悪いのはお前じゃなくて、俺の方だって話。

key: And sometimes you.
en: And sometimes you.
ja: あと、たまにお前も悪い。

key: Shit, I did it again.
en: Shit, I did it again.
ja: やべ、また言っちまった。

key: CAL: Anyway, if you'll let me continue,
en: CAL: Anyway, if you'll let me continue,
ja: キャル: とにかく、続けさせてもらうと、

key: I recall hearing a story somewhere about how Ametrine used to be a volcano as well.
en: I recall hearing a story somewhere about how Ametrine used to be a volcano as well.
ja: 昔アメトリンも火山だったって話、どこかで聞いた気がするんだ。

key: If it's just been dormant all this time, and Heatran wakes it up...
en: If it's just been dormant all this time, and Heatran wakes it up...
ja: ずっと休火山だっただけで、ヒードランがそれを目覚めさせたりしたら……

key: BLAKE: You don't gotta finish that thought.
en: BLAKE: You don't gotta finish that thought.
ja: ブレイク: その先は言わなくていいぞ。

key: No way that's happening.
en: No way that's happening.
ja: そんなこと、絶対起こらせねえ。

key: Let's hop to it, bro. Start us off!
en: Let's hop to it, bro. Start us off!
ja: さっさとやろうぜ、兄弟。まずはお前からだ!

key: CAL: Understood.
en: CAL: Understood.
ja: キャル: 分かった。

key: BLAKE: My turn?
en: BLAKE: My turn?
ja: ブレイク: 俺の番か?

key: BLAKE: Walrein, let's put 'em on ice!
en: BLAKE: Walrein, let's put 'em on ice!
ja: ブレイク: トドゼルガ、こいつらを凍らせてやろうぜ!

key: BLAKE: That's cool.
en: BLAKE: That's cool.
ja: ブレイク: そりゃクールだ。

key: Just try to not burn the entire place down.
en: Just try to not burn the entire place down.
ja: ここを丸ごと燃やしたりしないようにな。

key: CAL: While the room's heated, ice will melt, and some rocks will become warm and susceptible to breaking.
en: CAL: While the room's heated, ice will melt, and some rocks will become warm and susceptible to breaking.
ja: キャル: 部屋が温まってる間は、氷が溶けて、岩の一部も熱で砕けやすくなるはずだよ。

key: Certain crystals that have been tainted by Heatran's power might also allow you to break nearby ice.
en: Certain crystals that have been tainted by Heatran's power might also allow you to break nearby ice.
ja: ヒードランの力に染まった結晶なら、近くの氷を砕けるようになるかもしれない。

key: However, some of the water will become too warm for any Pokémon to cross.
en: However, some of the water will become too warm for any Pokémon to cross.
ja: ただ、水の一部はどのポケモンでも渡れないくらい熱くなるはずだ。

key: CAL: Do you want me to take over?
en: CAL: Do you want me to take over?
ja: キャル: 僕が代わろうか?

key: CAL: Right. Then stand back; we're turning up the heat.
en: CAL: Right. Then stand back; we're turning up the heat.
ja: キャル: よし。じゃあ下がってて、温度を上げるよ。

key: Just let me know.
en: Just let me know.
ja: 合図をくれればいいから。

key: BLAKE: Walrein and I got this; it's chill.
en: BLAKE: Walrein and I got this; it's chill.
ja: ブレイク: トドゼルガと俺に任せとけ、楽勝だ。

key: While it's cooling down the room, some water will freeze over into ice.
en: While it's cooling down the room, some water will freeze over into ice.
ja: 部屋が冷えてる間、水の一部が凍って氷になるはずだ。

key: The boiling water won't freeze, and will become cool enough to swim in.
en: The boiling water won't freeze, and will become cool enough to swim in.
ja: 煮えたぎってた水は凍らずに、泳げるくらいまで冷めるだろう。

key: Additionally, some of these crystals may be able to be popped to open up pathways across the lava.
en: Additionally, some of these crystals may be able to be popped to open up pathways across the lava.
ja: それに、この結晶の一部を割れば、溶岩を渡る通り道が開けるかもな。

key: You got it by now, right?
en: You got it by now, right?
ja: もう分かっただろ?

key: It's frozen solid in place...
en: It's frozen solid in place...
ja: ここは完全に凍りついている……

key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: 鍵が結晶に反応した!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
